title: What happens to my money when I give
description: Karen Community Church is accredited by the Evangelical Council for Financial Accountability. That means we adhere to high standards of biblical accountability, board governance, financial transparency, integrity in fundraising, and proper use of charitable resources. We make our financial statements freely available to view, and you are always welcome to contact our Giving Experience Team with general questions about our financial practices. To learn more about our standards for financial integrity, visit www.cfms.org or watch this video.

title: Why Should I Tithe?
description: In Malachi 3:10, God tells us to bring the tithe, which is 10% of our income, to Him. Later, Jesus affirms this in the New Testament.

title: Why should I give to Karen Church
description: When you give to Karen Community Church, God does something amazing. He multiplies your gifts and does more with it than any of us could ask or imagine. Your tithe becomes part of God’s plan to resource the local church to do His work here on earth. And He also allows you to be a part of all He is doing in your community and around the world through local and global missions partners. Know that we honor your gifts with faithful stewardship, ethical business practices, and full accountability so that the financial integrity of Karen Community Church remains beyond reproach.

title: The best way to give
description: The easiest and best way to give is through the Karen Community Church app. You can make a gift, schedule your giving, and review your giving history all in one place. You can also access current and past messages, check in to LifeKids or to serve, listen to the Craig Groeschel Leadership Podcast, and much more. Visit www.Karen Community Church/app to download the app for free today.

title: Can I give above my tithe to a specific area
description: Yes! Karen Community Church has five areas for giving above the tithe through an offering: New Locations, Local & Global Missions, Free Resources, Digital Reach, and YouVersion & Bible Translation. You can learn more about each of these at www.Karen Community Church/giving.

title: What is the most cost effective method of giving
description: The most cost-effective method of giving to Karen Community Church is the “bank account” option. This method has the lowest processing costs which allows us to put more of your gift to work in ministry.
